2608.29189.title: Rate-Coding Bundle Memory: A Unified Model of Memory and Control for Symbolic Computation in the Brain
2608.29189.paper_summary: We propose a neurobiologically plausible model of cognition that combines the advantages of connectionist and symbolic systems, and that can explain a wide range of cognitive phenomena. This model, called Rate-Coding Bundle Memory (RCBM), is based on the Symbolic Subsystem Hypothesis, which posits that the brain implements a symbolic subsystem within its fundamentally connectionist nature. RCBM is a hybrid model that uses rate coding to represent symbols in a continuous space, and it uses a bundle memory system to store and retrieve these symbols. The model is capable of solving a wide range of cognitive phenomena, including one-shot learning, pattern separation, and the binding problem. We argue that RCBM provides a promising framework for understanding the nature of cognition, and that it can be used to develop more sophisticated models of cognition in the future.
2608.29189.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一個神經生物學上合理的認知模型，結合了連結主義和符號系統的優勢，並能解釋廣泛的認知現象。這個模型稱為速率編碼束記憶（Rate-Coding Bundle Memory, RCBM），基於符號子系統假說，該假說認為大腦在其根本的連結主義本質中實現了一個符號子系統。RCBM是一個混合模型，使用速率編碼在連續空間中表示符號，並使用束記憶系統來存儲和檢索這些符號。該模型能夠解決廣泛的認知現象，包括一次性學習、模式分離和綁定問題。我們認為RCBM為理解認知的本質提供了一個有前景的框架，並且可以用來在未來開發更複雜的認知模型。
